{"[2021DO2088]": "We examine the grounds of appeal.

1. 공소사실 요지  
The gist of the facts charged in this case is as follows.  
피고인은 주류업체인 주식회사 B hereinafter referred to as “B”의 사내이사로, 피해자와 주류 supply 거래를 해왔던 사람이다. The Defendant, having filed a civil action against the Victim seeking payment of 주류대금, received and held KRW 4,700,000 on September 30, 2019, remitted by the Victim to an account in the name of B managed by the Defendant, during the civil dispute. However, the above amount was money the Victim had intended to remit to Co., Ltd. C, and was remitted to the Defendant by mistake of account number, and the Defendant was obligated to return the above amount after being notified by the Victim through text message on October 1, 2019 that the above amount had been remitted by mistake. Nevertheless, without any agreement with the Victim concerning set-off and settlement, the Defendant unilaterally set off and settled KRW 1,108,310, being the amount of the liquor-price claim asserted by the Defendant, and then refused to return the money and embezzled it.

2. 원심판단  
The court below held that, with respect to the money mistakenly remitted by the Victim to the Defendant, so long as a custodial relationship under the principle of good faith is recognized between the Defendant and the Victim, the Defendant could not unilaterally set off such money as with money entrusted by limiting its purpose or use; accordingly, it judged the facts charged in this case to be guilty on the ground that the Defendant’s act constitutes “반환의 거부,” an element of the crime of embezzlement, and that the intent of unlawful acquisition is also recognized.

3. 대법원의 판단  
a. Since “반환의 거부” as prescribed in Article 355(1) of the Criminal Act means an act of expressing an intention to exclude the owner’s rights over the thing held in custody, in order for “반환의 거부” to constitute embezzlement, it is insufficient that a person who keeps another’s property in custody merely refused to return it; by comprehensively considering the reason for the refusal to return and the subjective intentions, the refusal to return must be such that it may be viewed as equivalent to an act of embezzlement. The intent of unlawful acquisition in the crime of embezzlement refers to the intention of a person who keeps another’s property in custody to dispose of it as if he or she were the owner, without just title, contrary to the purpose thereof; therefore, even if return is refused, if there is a justifiable reason for the refusal to return, it cannot be said that there was intent of unlawful acquisition. 대법원 1998. 7. 10. 선고 98도126 판결, 대법원 2002. 9. 4. 선고 2000도637 판결, 대법원 2015. 2. 26. 선고 2014도11552 판결 등 참조.

b. Examining the following circumstances, as discernible from the reasons of the judgment of the court below and the record, in light of such legal principles, the Defendant’s act of refusing to return the portion corresponding to B’s claim against the Victim among the money remitted to the account in B’s name by the Victim’s mistake may be viewed as an exercise of a valid right of set-off; accordingly, it is difficult to accept as is the court below’s determination that the Defendant’s refusal to return constitutes an act of embezzlement and that the intent of unlawful acquisition is recognized.

(1) Where money has been mistakenly remitted to and deposited in a deposit account by error, a custodial relationship under the principle of good faith is established between the recipient and the remitter 대법원 2010. 12. 9. 선고 2010도891 판결, 대법원 2018. 7. 19. 선고 2017도17494 전원합의체 판결 등 참조; however, absent special circumstances, this alone does not mean that the money remitted by mistake by the remitter is identical to money expressly entrusted by the entrustor with a specified purpose and use, nor can it be evaluated that the recipient’s exercise of a set-off right against the remitter is contrary to the original intent of the entrustment on the ground that the remitter entrusted the recipient with affairs involving the receipt and payment of money.

(2) In light of the progress of the related civil case, B appears to have held a claim for payment of goods corresponding to the amount of the refusal to return against the Victim as of the time of the refusal to return described in the facts charged in this case. There also appears to be no material or circumstances suggesting that, at that time, the above claim for payment of goods of B and the Victim’s claim for return of unjust enrichment were not in set-offable relation, or that B’s exercise of the right of set-off constituted a violation of the principle of good faith or an abuse of rights.

(3) The Defendant returned, on the day after the remittance, the remainder of the KRW 4,700,000 mistakenly remitted, excluding the amount corresponding to B’s above claim for payment of goods in the amount of KRW 1,108,310, and even with respect to the KRW 1,108,310, appears to have sufficiently made clear to the Victim, who requested its return, the intention to exercise the right of set-off using B’s above claim for payment of goods as the automatic claim. In this manner, when examining the reason for and subjective intention behind the Defendant’s refusal to return the money corresponding to the amount of the above claim for payment of goods, it is difficult to conclude that the Defendant refused to return it with intent of unlawful acquisition.

c. Nevertheless, the court below judged the facts charged to be guilty by regarding the Defendant’s refusal to return as equivalent to an act of embezzlement in the crime of embezzlement and recognizing the intent of unlawful acquisition. The judgment of the court below contains an error that affected the judgment by misapprehending the legal principles concerning the act of embezzlement and the intent of unlawful acquisition in the crime of embezzlement and by failing to conduct the necessary review.

4. 결론  
The judgment of the court below is reversed, and the case is remanded to the court below for further trial and determination. It is so adjudged in accordance with the unanimous opinion of the participating Justices, as stated in the disposition."}

{"[80DO306]": "In considering 피고인들의 각 변호인 and 피고인 G himself가 제출한 각 상고이유(그 일부의 보충이유 포함), for convenience in this judgment we will collectively call them ‘상고이유’, and we will broadly divide and 판단 them item by item in the following order.

아래
제1 공소 기각의 결정을 간과한 위법
제2 절차상의 위법
1. 불고불리의 원칙에 위배
2. 공개재판 위반
3. 신문제한의 불법
4. 퇴정명령의 불법
5. 증인신문절차의 위법
6. 변호인 없이 개정한 위법
7. 변호권의 박탈
8. 공판조서의 미비와 열람등 사권의 박탈
9. 재판의 독립성 침해
제3 검찰관작성의 피의자신문조서에 대한 임의성 문제
제4 범죄구성요건에 관한 위법
1. 국헌문란의 목적
2. 폭동
3. 가담
4. 살해
5. 내란의 실행미수 및 기수시기
6. 증거은닉
제5 살인죄의 공동정범에 관한 위법
제6 중지미수에 관한 위법
제7 위법성저각사유
1. 정당행위
(1) 저항권 이론
(2) 정당한 직무집행
(3) 상관의 명령
2. 정당방위
3. 긴급피난
(1) 피고인 A의 경우
(2) 피고인 C의 경우
제8 책임저각사유
제9 양형부당
제10 결론
제11 소수의견
1. 대법원판사 민문기의 의견
2. 대법원판사 양병호의 의견
3. 대법원판사 임항준의 의견
4. 대법원판사 김윤행의 의견
5. 대법원판사 정태원의 의견
6. 대법원판사 서윤홍의 의견

제1 공소 기각의 결정을 간과한 위법
Among the grounds of appeal, it is argued that even on the facts stated in the indictment, there is no concrete statement as to 국헌문란의 목적, 폭동행위, 공모내용, or 실행의 분담 in the 공동정범 of 살인죄, so the facts charged were not specified and an order dismissing the prosecution should have been entered under 군법회의법 제373조 제1항 제4호. But the lower court overlooked this and allegedly misunderstood the legal principles. Upon review, this point had already been lawfully considered by the lower court, and the facts charged against the Defendants, as organized by the indictment and the two applications to amend the indictment, are sufficiently specific on their face. In addition, as to 피고인 C, the indictment clearly alleges 공모공동정범, so the omission of execution-sharing facts cannot be a defect. Accordingly, this argument is without merit.

제2 절차상의 위법
1. 불고불리의 원칙에 위배
It is argued that the indictment and the amendment application charged 피고인 G with killing T and U for the purpose of subverting the Constitution, but the lower judgment found that B, T, V, W, X, and U were killed, which is said to violate the principle of accusation and adjudication. Yet according to the lawfully granted amendment application at the first-instance trial date, 피고인 G was clearly prosecuted for killing T and U among the six deceased persons for the purpose of 국헌문란. Although the lower judgment’s conclusion language was somewhat inaccurate, the lower court had already found that after the other Defendants fired at the deceased persons, G received an instruction to perform 확인사살 on persons not yet fully dead and agreed to participate. Thus, the judgment was within the scope of prosecution, and the argument fails.

2. 공개재판 위반
It is argued that the first-instance 군법회의 unlawfully held Defendant A’s defense counsel questioning and cross-examination in closed session on 1979.12.8 without satisfying the statutory requirements, and also effectively barred public access on 1979.12.18 without even entering a formal closure order. But the record shows that the closure on 1979.12.8 was made under 군법회의법 제67조, because the content of Defendant A’s testimony substantially involved matters that could affect 국가의 안전보장 or 안녕질서, and the reason is fully understandable from the record. As for the 1979.12.18 session, the first-instance transcript states that the trial was 법정공개, and under 군법회의법 제89조 the transcript alone proves that procedural fact. Therefore this part of the argument also lacks merit.

3. 신문제한의 불법
It is argued that the first-instance and lower courts excessively limited questioning and statements whenever specific references were made concerning the motive and purpose of the act, the domestic political situation immediately before the act, and the inevitability of the act, especially in relation to Defendant A, and frequently did so during the questioning of Defendants E and F. But reviewing the first-instance and appellate transcripts, it is clear that the Defendants were given necessary and sufficient opportunities to state their positions, and each defense counsel was granted enough opportunity to examine the defendants and other parties. In particular, Defendant A’s own statements, his supplemental appellate statement, and the reasons submitted by his counsel sufficiently reflect the defense content now asserted. So the contrary argument is without merit.

4. 퇴정명령의 불법
It is argued that on 1979.12.10, while questioning Defendant C, the first-instance court ordered Defendant A to withdraw from the courtroom under 군법회의법 제343조 제2항, and that after C’s statement ended, A should have been brought back in and informed of the substance, with the opportunity to question C directly. The record, however, shows that the withdrawal order was made ex officio because the court found the co-defendants could not make sufficient statements in each other’s presence. That measure was reasonable under the statute. It is true that A was not brought back in immediately that day, but the fourth trial transcript shows that when the hearing resumed, the legal officer informed all parties, including A and all counsel, of the substance of the previous hearing and asked for their views, and everyone said they had no particular opinion. Further, Defendant A’s appointed counsel later cross-examined C on his behalf. Therefore, no reversible error appears.

5. 증인신문절차의 위법
It is argued first that in the Z witness examination, Defendant A was excluded and thus denied participation and cross-examination rights. But the record shows that the first-instance court, at an eighth hearing attended by all defendants and counsel, ordered the legal officer to conduct the examination outside the courtroom, and on 1979.12.17 the examination was held at the Army Headquarters Judge Advocate General’s Office in the presence of Defendant C, his counsel, and counsel for Defendants A and D. A was notified and had an opportunity to participate. Also, the parties later said they had no particular opinion when informed of the substance, so any defect was waived under precedent, including 4294HYEONGSANG127, 67DO613, and 74DA3323. Second, it is argued that witnesses were not properly summoned under 군법회의법 제106조 내지 제108조 and were sometimes examined immediately upon application. Yet the record shows that witnesses present in court may be examined without summons under the proviso to 제192조, and the remaining witnesses were later examined with an opportunity for the parties to state opinions and conduct necessary cross-examination. So there is no reversible violation.

6. 변호인 없이 개정한 위법
It is argued that on 1980.1.22 the appellate court opened the hearing with only Defendants C and G present, without A, E, F or their counsel, even though military-court cases require counsel. But 군법회의법 제416조 is only a provision that appellate proceedings are a post hoc review, not a de novo trial, and that the defendant need not appear as a rule. It is not a rule authorizing selective appearance of only some co-defendants. So the appellate court’s measure was mistaken. Still, on 1980.1.23 the legal officer summarized the important matters of the previous hearing, and thereafter adequate cross-examination opportunity was afforded. The first instance had already sufficiently heard the issues now raised, and no new matter was heard at the first appellate date. Thus the mistake did not affect the judgment.

7. 변호권의 박탈
It is argued that under 군법회의법 제59조 the Defendant’s lineal family members and spouse have an independent right to appoint counsel, and therefore counsel appointed by Defendant A’s mother and spouse could not be excluded by military police at the fifth hearing on 1979.12.12. However, the appointing party may revoke the appointment on behalf of the principal. The record shows that during the fourth hearing, while privately retained counsel including AB were participating, Defendant A stated that he was refusing the defense by the private defense team, was informed that if private counsel were to be dismissed the military court must appoint assigned counsel, and then said he would revoke all private counsel and wanted assigned counsel appointed. Accordingly, the private counsel were lawfully revoked, and later exclusion from the courtroom does not amount to deprivation of counsel rights.

8. 공판조서의 미비와 열람등 사권의 박탈
It is argued that, even though 군법회의법 does not contain a provision like 형사소송법 제54조 requiring a transcript within five days, reading 제89조, 제86조, and 제64조 together means that transcripts should be prepared before the next hearing or at latest before the factual hearing ends, and the failure to do so deprived counsel of inspection and copying rights. But the Military Court-Martial Act does not set a statutory deadline like the Criminal Procedure Act, and while transcripts should indeed be prepared promptly, there is no definite cutoff. Even the Criminal Procedure Act deadline is directive, not voiding the transcript merely for late completion. The record shows no defect in the timing of the first-instance and appellate transcripts, and the defendants’ defense rights were fully protected. Thus this argument fails.

9. 재판의 독립성 침해
It is argued that the courts pressed ahead as if under a fixed unlawful schedule that violated the defendants’ defense and counsel rights, and that notes from outside were openly handed through the back door to the judges. But the earlier claims of procedural illegality have already been rejected as meritless, and the record does not show that the courts were driven by any predetermined schedule. The first instance held eight factual hearings over the second through ninth dates, and the appellate court held three hearings over the first through third dates, while protecting the defense and counsel rights. There is also absolutely no record of contact notes being delivered, let alone evidence that they violated judicial independence. This point is too abstract and fabricated to require further discussion.

제3 검찰관작성의 피의자신문조서에 대한 임의성 문제
It is argued that the suspect-interrogation records prepared by the military prosecutor were merely an extension of the military-police records because the defendants were exhausted from torture under martial law, and that Defendant A made involuntary statements due to his liver disease and dim consciousness. It is also argued that because access to counsel and family was fully blocked, the prosecutor’s interrogation was only a legal refinement of the military police records and thus lacked voluntariness, so the lower court erred in using them as evidence and failed to address the appeal grounds. But generally, absence of voluntariness means the statement was not made in a free atmosphere due to threats, torture, or similar means. The determination is made by the judge’s reasonable free conviction based on the entire litigation process, including the document’s preparation and content, the defendant’s explanation and demeanor, the prosecutor’s elucidation, and witness testimony. Here the record shows that Defendant A confirmed the prosecutor’s records, signed and sealed them, said there was no coercion or threat, and stated in cross-examination that he had been investigated at the JSA and later at the Judge Advocate General’s Office. Other defendants likewise said they told the truth and read the contents. No testimony indicates that they were investigated under assault or deception. The contents of the prosecutor’s records are largely consistent across defendants, especially for C, D, E, and G, including two separate rounds of questioning. Their courtroom statements also broadly align with the prosecutor statements on objective facts, differing mainly on subjective motive, and the record overall supports voluntariness. Accordingly, the lower court properly admitted those records, and there is no legal error.

제4 범죄구성요건에 관한 위법
1. 국헌문란의 목적
The argument is that ‘국헌문란’ in Articles 88 and 87 of the Criminal Act means the unlawful destruction of the State’s political basic order, i.e. liberal democracy, and that merely overthrowing a government, shouting overthrow slogans, killing a specific constitutional organ as a natural person, or planning succession does not suffice. The Court agrees with the legal principle that 국헌문란 means unlawfully destroying the constitutional and legal political order and that intent belongs to strict proof, requiring only conditional awareness, not necessarily definite knowledge. The key issue is whether the lower court’s factual findings on each defendant are proper.

For Defendant A, the lower court found that while his anti-democratic Yushin system had failed repeatedly and he felt insecure after criticism from President B, he planned to kill the President, seize power, declare martial law on the ground of security and disorder, use the Central Intelligence Agency’s power and organization to control the martial-law forces, suppress the situation by force, form a revolutionary committee overseeing legislative, judicial, and executive power, become chairman, secure a base of power, and run for President. The record, however, also contains his repeated statements that the act was for 민주회복, that he called it 혁명 to abolish the Yushin order, and that constitutional revision and elections would be done through proper procedure. There are also statements about recruiting the Army Chief of Staff, maintaining secrecy, and later creating a constitutional drafting process. Still, the Court concludes the lower court’s fact-finding was proper because the evidence shows a conditional intent to unlawfully destroy the political basic order, and the claimed democratic-restoration motive cannot be accepted as a factual defense. Yet separate opinions exist on this point for all six defendants, and in particular Justices Min Mun-gi, Yang Byeong-ho, Im Hang-jun, Kim Yun-haeng, and Seo Yun-hong present contrary views in Section 11.

As to Defendant C, the lower court treated him as having the purpose of 국헌문란 even though he was the Presidential Chief Secretary, not a constitutional organ like the President, and even though the record shows his conduct was often reactive to A’s actions and later became a report to the Prime Minister and military leaders. The majority nevertheless holds that his acts of security maintenance, troop-movement prohibition, reporting, and recommendation of martial law could constitute 중요한 임무 and that he knowingly participated in the insurrectionary process. However, there are strong separate opinions that the evidence is insufficient to treat him as a conspirator in the murder of T or as having the requisite insurrectionary purpose.

As to Defendants D, E, F, and G, the majority finds that their statements and conduct—driven by orders, positions, trust relations, and their role in the Gungjeong-dong restaurant shooting and the later 확인사살—sufficiently show knowledge of a coup-like state of upheaval and thereby 국헌문란의 목적. The dissenters disagree, arguing that mere compliance with superior orders, vague statements like ‘if things go well, you’ll get a share’, or recognition that a coup might happen is not enough to prove a purpose to destroy the constitutional order.

2. 폭동
The argument is that a riot under Article 87 requires a combination of many persons with some organization using violence or intimidation to a degree that disturbs local peace, and that the Defendants did not form such a combination or reach that degree. The Court states that riot means a combination of many persons acting with violence or intimidation, and the number need not be precisely fixed; organization need only be to some degree, and the offense is consummated when local peace is actually disturbed. The majority holds that the group structure in this case, with sequential participation and role division among A, C, D, E, F, and G, was enough to constitute a combination of many persons, and the gunfire itself was violence or intimidation. Although the conduct may not have fully reached the level of disturbing local peace, the later anticipated gun battle and military clashes show the riot continued. Thus the lower judgment properly treated the conduct as attempted insurrection where appropriate. But dissenting justices, including Min Mun-gi, Im Hang-jun, Kim Yun-haeng, Yang Byeong-ho, and Seo Yun-hong in various combinations, argue that this was not a sufficient mob combination and that the legal application of Article 87 was erroneous.

3. 가담
The argument is that Defendant C, as a civil servant, did not have a hierarchical status under A and did not join a conspiratorial group for insurrection. The Court rejects that view, holding that C clearly participated in the insurrectionary acts through his security-maintenance and related conduct. The majority also says that C’s conversation with A after the President’s assassination shows sufficient communication of intent, and that the fact he was not in a subordinate status is not an obstacle. Again, however, separate opinions dispute the existence of sufficient mutual communication or conspiratorial participation.

4. 살해
It is argued that T and U may already have been dead when G fired his shots, so the lower court erred in recognizing murder. The majority, based on the autopsy and scene records and witness testimony, holds that T and U were alive until immediately before G’s confirmatory shots and were then finally killed by those shots. In murder, the object is a living person, and if independent acts each caused death, each act may be punished as a consummated offense. Therefore the lower judgment is upheld. But Justices Min Mun-gi, Im Hang-jun, Jeong Tae-won, and Seo Yun-hong present separate opinions questioning whether G’s shots were aimed at living victims or at corpses and whether the record sufficiently supports the timing of death.

5. 내란의 실행착수 및 기수시기
It is argued that insurrection becomes consummated once a riot begins and reaches the degree of disturbing local peace, regardless of whether the constitutional-subversion purpose is achieved, so Defendant C should not have been convicted of attempted major-participation in insurrection. The Court agrees that insurrection may be consummated once a riot reaches that level, but here the conduct described in the lower judgment alone did not rise to that degree. The majority also notes that the post-shooting conduct in the Army hospital, Blue House, Army Headquarters banka, and Ministry of National Defense shows the riot did not end immediately after the Gungjeong-dong shooting, and Defendant C’s later arrest does not negate his participation in a continuing riot. Nonetheless, separate opinions again disagree, especially about whether C’s later conduct was truly part of a riot or merely post-offense conduct.

6. 증거은닉
The argument is that evidence concealment requires both an objective relation to another person’s criminal or disciplinary case and the subjective intent to conceal. Defendant H allegedly did not know the items were evidence and had no intent to hide them. But the Court finds that H knew the President had come to the banquet room, heard ongoing gunfire, armed himself, later learned of the President’s absence, understood absence to mean death, and received E’s instruction to wrap and bury the pistols. Taken together, the lower court’s finding and legal application are proper, and no violation of the rules of evidence or misunderstanding of law appears.

제5 살인죄의 공동정범에 관한 위법
The argument is that Defendant C did not conspire with A to kill T, because 공동정범 requires a concrete agreement on contents, means, and method, plus joint execution, and mere casual conversation or nodding is not enough. The Court, however, holds that the lower court clearly applied 공모공동정범 to C, and that precedent holds that even a non-executing co-conspirator remains liable if others execute the planned crime. In the majority’s view, the conversation at the restaurant garden, the nodding, the post hoc statements, and C’s later conduct sufficiently show mutual communication and a subjective intent to realize his own crime through A. The Court further says A’s killing of T was carried out in the context of the agreed plan. Therefore the lower judgment is upheld. Yet strong dissenting opinions, especially from Justices Min Mun-gi, Yang Byeong-ho, Im Hang-jun, Kim Yun-haeng, and Seo Yun-hong, argue there was no high-level conspiracy and no sufficient proof that C intended to kill T through A.

제6 중지미수에 관한 위법
The argument is that the lower court wrongly treated Defendant C’s conduct as attempted major participation in insurrection even though the claimed reasons for failure, such as the Prime Minister’s and ministers’ opposition or Blue House Chief Secretary Z’s pressure, were not shown to be decisive obstacles, and C later had the ability to help A but instead caused his arrest. The Court, after reviewing the record, finds the lower court’s conclusion proper. The record shows that C’s statements about the cabinet meeting, the disagreement over whether to say the President was dead or absent, the ministers’ strong reaction, and the fact that C ultimately reversed course and had A arrested, support the lower court’s finding. Therefore the argument of abandonment of attempt fails.

제7 위법성저각사유
1. 정당행위
(1) 저항권 이론
The argument is that the so-called 저항권, recognized in modern constitutional theory as a natural right even without express textual basis, should justify A and D’s acts because the Yushin system was anti-democratic and anti-human-rights, and no lawful remedial procedure was possible. The Court reaffirms the prior precedent 74DA3323, holding that a supra-positive right cannot be used to justify conduct contrary to existing positive law. Even if one accepts a natural-law theory of resistance, a judge cannot employ it as a judicial norm absent positive-law grounding. Therefore the argument to change precedent is rejected. Still, there is a separate opinion from Justices Min Mun-gi and Im Hang-jun.

(2) 정당한 직무집행
The argument is that C’s acts—security maintenance, troop-movement prohibition, reporting to the Prime Minister, and recommending martial law—were legitimate official acts under Article 20. The Court says this is merely a false exculpatory explanation, and those acts were in fact active participation in A’s insurrection. Hence no lawful-act defense applies.

(3) 상관의 명령
The argument is that D’s acts followed A’s orders as Central Intelligence Agency chief and thus were lawful. The Court states that a superior has no authority to order a subordinate to commit crimes or other unlawful acts, and a subordinate need not obey a clearly illegal order. So the argument is plainly without merit.

2. 정당방위
The argument is that the so-called Bu-Ma situation and the broader political crisis justified A’s act as defense against present unlawful infringement on the lives and property of the sovereign people. The Court rejects this. The record does not support a genuine intent to avert imminent harm; rather, the evidence shows that A planned to kill the President and seize power, while the claims about a future nationwide uprising and alleged shooting orders were unsupported and speculative. Thus the requisites of Article 21(1) were not satisfied.

3. 긴급피난
(1) As to A, the Court says the same reasoning as for self-defense defeats the necessity claim.
(2) As to C, the Court says his claimed necessity—preventing bloodshed among our own troops and preventing a North Korean provocation—was not shown by the record to have been his true intent. The later conduct, including the false report to the Prime Minister, the failure to consult the Capital Defense Commander, and the eventual arrest of A, shows that his insurrectionary participation came before any claimed intent to avoid danger. So necessity is not established.

제8 책임저각사유
The argument is that Central Intelligence Agency personnel were under a much stricter superior-subordinate system than ordinary soldiers, so they could not judge legality or refuse orders, and therefore D, E, F, G, and H acted under compulsion or without reasonable alternative. The Court rejects this, noting that public officials are not bound to obey clearly unlawful orders, and even if absolute obedience was an informal rule inside the Agency, that alone does not make these plainly unlawful acts compelled conduct. The record shows the defendants had enough freedom, time, and spatial opportunity to refuse and leave if they had not been motivated by the expected reward from the revolutionary act. Therefore the defense of compulsion or absence of reasonable expectation fails.

제9 양형부당
The argument is that military-court defendants should be allowed to appeal excessive sentencing because Article 432 of the Military Court-Martial Act conflicts with the Constitution, and because the death penalty itself is excessively severe in light of modern civilized countries and the defendants’ circumstances. The Court holds that military courts are special courts established for special purposes, and the Constitution and laws anticipated their different treatment. Therefore Article 432 is not unconstitutional on this ground, and the sentencing-excess argument fails. Separate opinions from Justices Min Mun-gi and Im Hang-jun appear on this point.

제10 결론
As explained above, there are separate opinions on parts of the appeal by Justices Min Mun-gi, Yang Byeong-ho, Im Hang-jun, Kim Yun-haeng, Jeong Tae-won, and Seo Yun-hong, depending on the defendant and issue. Nevertheless, the majority holds that the relevant grounds of appeal are without merit, and the remaining grounds are unanimously without merit. Accordingly, all appeals by the Defendants are dismissed. As to Defendant H, under Article 57 of the Criminal Act, all days of pretrial detention before this judgment is pronounced in the appellate instance are credited toward the principal sentence, and judgment is rendered as stated in the operative part.

제11 소수의견
1. 대법원판사 민문기의 의견
Justice Min Mun-gi says that the insurrection here is inherently a highly political crime, and because regime change was actually involved, the political situation must be viewed. In his view, the nationwide consensus to draft a new constitution after the death of President B means that the Yushin system had already been practically abolished, so punishing the act as insurrection is legally impossible once that new consensus existed. He analogizes this to a hypothetical monarchy-transition case: once nationwide consensus abolishes the old democratic system, insurrection cannot later be punished merely because the new constitutional order is being sought. Therefore he concludes the lower judgment’s legal reasoning is flawed.

2. 대법원판사 양병호의 의견
Justice Yang Byeong-ho, considering Defendant A’s, Defendant C’s, and other defendants’ grounds together, says the evidence shows A’s original aim was to kill the President, declare martial law, control the martial-law forces, establish a revolutionary committee, and later run for President. But he finds the evidence insufficient to prove 국헌문란의 목적 beyond reasonable doubt. He stresses that A repeatedly said the act was to abolish the Yushin system and restore democracy, and that terms like 혁명 or 혁명위원회 do not by themselves prove a plan to overthrow the constitutional order. He also rejects the lower court’s finding of conspiracy between C and A regarding T’s killing, saying the phrase ‘해치워버릴까’ does not necessarily mean kill, and the nodding and surrounding circumstances do not establish a high-level agreement or shared execution. He further questions the classification of E, F, D, and G’s acts as insurrectionary murder. In his view, the lower judgment should be reversed.

3. 대법원판사 임항준의 의견
Justice Im Hang-jun says that the defendants were not a sufficient 다수인 결합 to constitute a riot under Article 87, and even if they were, the acts would still only amount to one offense under Article 88 rather than imaginary concurrence with attempted insurrection. He also argues that E, F, and C lack evidence of insurrectionary murder, and that C cannot be treated as A’s conspiracy co-principal in T’s killing. On the final point, he questions both Article 432 of the Military Court-Martial Act and the rejection of the right of resistance, arguing that civilians tried by military courts should not be deprived of appeal on excessive sentencing, and that a resistance right should not be categorically denied as a judicial norm.

4. 대법원판사 김윤행의 의견
Justice Kim Yun-haeng agrees that insurrection requires a mob-like combination sufficient to disturb local peace, and thus A, C, D, E, F, and G should not be subject to Article 87 as the majority held. He also agrees with Justice Im that C cannot be treated as A’s conspiracy co-principal in T’s killing. He further argues that if the conduct were insurrectionary murder, then punishing it as imaginary concurrence with attempted insurrection distorts the statutory scheme, because Article 87 already contemplates acts like killing within riot conduct. He therefore says the lower court’s legal application was wrong and affected the judgment.

5. 대법원판사 정태원의 의견
Justice Jeong Tae-won’s opinion is the same as part of Justice Seo Yun-hong’s opinion concerning Defendants E and F, and the part concerning Defendant G.

6. 대법원판사 서윤홍의 의견
Justice Seo Yun-hong says he cannot agree with the majority’s decision to uphold all convictions against C, E, F, and G. As to C, he argues that the evidence shows only a possibly ambiguous nod to A’s remark and later passive conduct, but not the high-level conspiracy required for conspiracy co-principal liability. He says the real principal of the President’s assassination was A, not C. He also says the record does not prove that C’s later conduct amounted to attempted insurrection, because the critical issue is whether he truly shared the purpose of subverting the Constitution. As to E and F, he says their statements only show they thought they might get promoted or get a share if things went well, not that they knew of an unconstitutional overthrow or the President’s assassination. As to G, he argues that the time of the so-called confirmatory shots suggests the victims may already have been dead, and that without proper expert assessment the court could not safely infer murder with insurrectionary purpose. Therefore, he concludes that the lower judgment as to C, E, F, and G should not have been maintained.

{"[84DO114]": "We examine the 상고이유.

According to the 이유기재 of the first instance judgment upheld by the lower court, the first instance court, by 종합 the 거시증거 cited therein, found that the Defendant, on or about 1982.10.29. 14:00, at 서울민사지방법원 제217호 법정, after taking the oath as the 원고측 증인 in case 82나1174, an 손해배상청구사건 between 원고 조보경 and 피고 이월분, made a 허위의 진술 contrary to her memory to Judge 전충환 of that court, saying, “300,000원중에 165,200원을 공제한 잔액 134,800원을 원고가 받았다” thereby committing 위증, even though she did not know the 내용 thereof but stated as if she knew them.

In 위증죄, the 허위의 진술 referred to does not mean that the 객관적 사실 is false, but means a statement made contrary to one’s memory of facts personally experienced, that is, a 사실에 반하는 기억; and according to the record of this case, not only has the Defendant consistently 부인 criminal intent, but even according to the 각 기재 in the 진술조서 prepared by the 사법경찰관 concerning the 고소인 이월분 and the 진술서 prepared by 이월분, the said 이월분 herself stated that, between her and the above 조보경, there were 거래관계 concerning 계금 and 다방경영, as well as 거래관계 concerning 보관금, and that there was an occasion when she applied 165,200원 out of the 보관금 to the 계금 and deducted it, and gave the remaining 34,800원을 to 조보경. However, she claimed that the 보관금 was 200,000원, and thus, after deducting the above 165,200원, the remainder was 34,800원, so that there is a difference of 100,000원 each between the 보관금 and the 지급금. Although 이월분 denies the fact of running a 다방 as a 동업 with 조보경, stating that she employed 조보경 as the 다방마담, and denies having received 700,000원을 as 동업자금조, what this means is that, separate from such 거래, there was a 보관금 to be returned to 조보경, and that she returned the remaining 돈 after deducting 165,200원 therefrom; accordingly, it cannot be 단정 that the Defendant’s 증언, in light of the above 사실, was a 허위의 공술 contrary to memory, and no other 증거 can be found sufficient to 인정 that the Defendant’s 증언 was a 허위의 진술 contrary to memory. Therefore, if the 사실심 was to 인정 the Defendant’s 범의, it should first have further 심리 the various 거래관계 between the above 조보경 and 이월분 and determine whether the Defendant’s 증언 was 전연터무니없는 것; nevertheless, without fully conducting such 심리, it held that testimony which substantially accorded even with the 객관적 사실 asserted by 이월분 was a 허위의 진술, and thus it is deemed to have erred by 오해 the 법리 of the offense of 위증, by failing to conduct sufficient 심리, and by 위반 the 채증법칙 and 오해 the 사실.

The 상고논지 is well taken.

Accordingly, the 원심판결 is 파기, and, in order to have the 원심 conduct a new 심리판단, the case is 환송 to the 서울형사지방법원 합의부; the opinions of the 관여법관 being in agreement, judgment is rendered as stated in the 주문."}

question: Which of the following statements concerning 압수·수색 are incorrect? (If there is 다툼, pursuant to 판례)
A: (a) If the 피압수자 expressly indicated to the 수사기관 that he would not participate in the execution of the 압수·수색영장, then, except in 특별한 사정, it is permissible not to separately guarantee his 변호인 an opportunity to participate in the execution of the 압수·수색영장. (b) If, after the 수사기관 has selectively 압수한 정보 related to the alleged crime and is retaining the remaining 정보 unrelated thereto without deleting, discarding, or returning it, then, as to the portion unrelated to the alleged crime, it has unlawfully 압수 and 수색한 전자정보 beyond the scope of electronic information subject to seizure without a warrant, and such 위법성 cannot be deemed cured merely because a 압수·수색영장 was later issued by a court or because the defendant or defense counsel consented to its use as evidence. (c) The term 피의자의 소유·관리에 속하는 정보저장매체, for which the right of 참여 should be guaranteed not only to the 피압수자 who voluntarily submitted the 정보저장매체 but also to a suspect who is not the voluntary submitter, means a case in which the suspect, at the time of the 압수·수색 or up to a temporally proximate time, actually controlled and managed the 정보저장매체 and possessed and exercised exclusive authority to manage and dispose of all 전자정보 within that 정보저장매체, and did not otherwise transfer or relinquish it to a third party according to his own intent, so that the suspect can be evaluated as the 실질적 피압수자 with respect to the 전자정보 stored in that 정보저장매체. (d) Whether a person qualifies as the 실질적 피압수자 must be determined on the basis of the 외형적 and 객관적으로 인식가능한 factual condition at the time of the 압수·수색; thus, if the suspect or any other third party had, in the past, been involved in the use of that 정보저장매체 or the creation or use of individual 전자정보, or if they are the 정보주체 identified by 전자정보 created in the course thereof, then they must be treated as the party 실질적으로 subjected to 압수 and 수색. (e) If, while voluntarily submitting a 휴대전화, the suspect voluntarily provided the 수사기관 with the ID and 비밀번호 for accessing 클라우드 services or the like, with the intent of submitting to the 수사기관 전자정보 stored not in the 휴대전화 but in 원격지 managed by a third party such as the 클라우드, then the 전자정보 stored in the 클라우드 or the like may be regarded as having been voluntarily submitted.
